```{r load-packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(factoextra)

source("courses/bdat-602/_teacher/resources/datasets/simulate_bdat602_data.R")
health_data <- simulate_bdat602(n = 500000, seed = 602)
```

## Task 1: Prepare and scale the clustering features

```{r task1-sample}
set.seed(602)
health_sub <- health_data[!is.na(health_data$bmi) &
                            !is.na(health_data$income), ]
health_sub <- health_sub[sample(nrow(health_sub), 50000), ]

cluster_vars <- c(
  "age", "bmi", "income", "premium",
  "num_chronic_conditions", "num_claims",
  "claim_amount", "support_calls",
  "customer_rating", "app_logins_monthly"
)
```

```{r task1-transform-scale}
# TODO: apply signed_log to income and log1p to claim_amount before scaling.
# signed_log <- function(x) sign(x) * log1p(abs(x))
# Then select the 10 cluster_vars, mutate income and claim_amount,
# run scale(), and convert to data frame.

signed_log <- function(x) sign(x) * log1p(abs(x))

# health_sub |> select(all_of(cluster_vars)) |>
#   mutate(income = signed_log(income), claim_amount = log1p(claim_amount)) |>
#   scale() |> as.data.frame()
health_scaled <- NULL

# Verify: means ~0, SDs ~1
colMeans(health_scaled) |> round(3)
apply(health_scaled, 2, sd) |> round(3)
```

## Task 4: Fit k-means, profile, and label clusters

```{r task4-fit}
set.seed(602)
# TODO: fit kmeans with chosen_k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 100
km_fit <- NULL  # kmeans(health_scaled, centers = chosen_k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 100)

cat("Variance explained:",
    round(km_fit$betweenss / km_fit$totss * 100, 1), "%\n")
cat("Cluster sizes:", km_fit$size, "\n")
```

```{r task4-profile}
health_sub$cluster <- factor(km_fit$cluster)

# TODO: group_by(cluster) and summarise:
# n, avg_age, avg_bmi, avg_income, avg_claims, pct_smoker, pct_fraud, pct_churned
cluster_profile <- health_sub |>
  group_by(cluster) |>
  summarise(
    n           = n(),
    avg_age     = NULL,  # mean(age)
    avg_bmi     = NULL,  # mean(bmi, na.rm = TRUE)
    avg_income  = NULL,  # mean(income, na.rm = TRUE)
    avg_claims  = NULL,  # mean(num_claims)
    pct_smoker  = NULL,  # mean(smoker) * 100
    pct_fraud   = NULL,  # mean(fraud_flag) * 100
    pct_churned = NULL   # mean(churned) * 100
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_claims))

print(cluster_profile)
```
